description: The settings of a swarm relay, edited from its own page. A save rebuilds the relay: nodes register and open their tunnels again within seconds.

logger.description: Process log level, per-component overrides, outputs, and rotation.

file.description: Destination file when outputs include file.
file.title: Log file path

format.description: text for human logs; json for structured logs.
format.title: Format

level.description: Minimum severity written to configured outputs.
level.title: Level

levels.description: Raise or lower one subsystem on its own. A parent name covers what is nested under it (gateway reaches gateway.telegram), and the longest match wins.
levels.title: Component levels

rotation.description: Size-based rotation when logging to a file.

max_files.description: How many rotated segments to retain; 0 uses logger defaults.
max_files.title: Max files

max_size_mb.description: Rotate after the file reaches this size; 0 uses logger defaults.
max_size_mb.title: Max file size (MB)

rotation.title: Rotation

logger.title: Logger

swarm.description: This relay's deployment: its name and address, the tokens of its clients and nodes, CORS for pages served elsewhere, the nodes it dials itself and the relays it joins. A save rebuilds the relay; a new address takes a restart.

allow_insecure.description: Let a relay bound off loopback run without a client token. For a lab only.
allow_insecure.title: Allow without a client token

allow_private_upstreams.description: Host names allowed to resolve into private ranges when a node advertises a URL.
allow_private_upstreams.title: Private upstream hosts

auth_token.description: Bearer token a client presents to use this relay, and every node behind it. Write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set. A new one signs out every client, this page included: enter it again with Connect to… in the environment menu.
auth_token.title: Client token

cors.description: Pages served from another origin, such as a laptop's coddy serve, that may call this relay from the browser.

allow_loopback.description: Also admit any page from the browser's own machine - localhost, *.localhost, 127.0.0.0/8 or [::1] on any port - such as a laptop's coddy serve, whatever port it took. The client token still applies.
allow_loopback.title: Allow loopback origins

allowed_origins.description: Exact origins, for example http://localhost:12345, or * for any.
allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins

enable.description: Answer cross-origin requests from the origins below.
enable.title: Enable CORS

cors.title: CORS

fanout_timeout_seconds.description: How long the aggregated session list and the topology wait for a node.
fanout_timeout_seconds.title: Fan-out timeout (seconds)

host.description: Address to bind. 0.0.0.0 listens on every interface. Takes effect on a restart.
host.title: Listen host

insecure_open_registration.description: Let any node join without a pairing token. For a lab only.
insecure_open_registration.title: Open registration

join.description: Parent relays this relay registers into, which is how relays chain.

advertise_url.description: Address the parent dials this relay at. Empty dials out: the parent drives this relay back down a tunnel.
advertise_url.title: Advertise URL

dial.description: How this end reaches the other one: an outbound proxy and the certificate check.

ca_file.description: PEM bundle trusted for the other end's certificate, besides the system roots.
ca_file.title: CA file

insecure_skip_verify.description: For a lab only: every connection is logged as insecure.
insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip certificate check

proxy.description: http, https, socks5 or socks5h proxy URL. It may carry a password, so it is write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set.
proxy.title: Proxy

dial.title: Dialling

name.description: Name this relay registers under; empty takes the host name.
name.title: Name

pairing_token.description: The parent's pairing token. Write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set.
pairing_token.title: Pairing token

token.description: This relay's own client token, which the parent presents when it proxies. Write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set.
token.title: Token

url.description: Parent relay this relay registers into.
url.title: Relay URL

join.title: Joins

lease_ttl_seconds.description: How long a registration lasts without a refresh; nodes refresh at a third of it.
lease_ttl_seconds.title: Lease TTL (seconds)

name.description: The relay's name on the map and in /swarm/info; empty takes the host name it runs on.
name.title: Name

pairing_tokens.description: Tokens a node presents to join this relay. Write-only: the list is served empty, and a list sent back empty keeps the tokens set; tokens entered here replace them all.
pairing_tokens.title: Pairing tokens

port.description: Port to bind. Takes effect on a restart.
port.title: Listen port

tls.description: Certificate and key the relay serves HTTPS with. Both or neither.
tls.title: TLS

upstreams.description: Nodes this relay dials itself, pinned on the map whether or not they check in.

dial.description: How this end reaches the other one: an outbound proxy and the certificate check.

ca_file.description: PEM bundle trusted for the other end's certificate, besides the system roots.
ca_file.title: CA file

insecure_skip_verify.description: For a lab only: every connection is logged as insecure.
insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip certificate check

proxy.description: http, https, socks5 or socks5h proxy URL. It may carry a password, so it is write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set.
proxy.title: Proxy

dial.title: Dialling

kind.description: agent, or relay for a relay chained under this one.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: Name the node is mounted under: /swarm/nodes/<name>.
name.title: Name

token.description: The node's own bearer token, which the relay presents when it proxies. Write-only: leave it empty to keep the one set.
token.title: Token

url.description: Address the relay dials the node at.
url.title: URL

upstreams.title: Upstreams

swarm.title: Swarm relay

title: Coddy relay config
